|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Master Kenobi]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (3 September 2021). The current text is [[Master Kenobi (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterkenobi.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterkenobi.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi (except Yoda) or [Permanent Weapon] cards; if a Rebel in battle, may use 1 Force to add 3 to your total power (5 if Luke); once per turn, may ▼ a battleground that is related to a location on table.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Kenobi (Errata)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterkenobi.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterkenobi.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi (except Yoda) or [Permanent Weapon] cards; if a Rebel in battle, may use 1 Force to add 3 to your total power (5 if Luke); once per turn, may ▼ a battleground that is related to a location on table.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
